newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-AZHARUDDIN HELPS INDIA TO 227 IN ASIA CUP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AZHARUDDIN HELPS INDIA TO 227 IN ASIA CUP.

text.p: India's Mohammad Azharuddin returned to form on Friday when he hit an unbeaten 81 to set world champions Sri Lanka a target of 228 to win their Asia Cup match at the R. Premadasa stadium.

Sri Lanka's decision to allow India to bat first looked like paying dividends when the home side picked up three cheap wickets, including that of India skipper Sachin Tendulkar for 21 when he stepped out to drive fast bowler Chaminda Vaas and lost his off stump.

But former India captain Azharuddin, overlooked by selectors for the recent Independence Cup tournament and whose selection for the Asia Cup raised some eyebrows, pulled India from a perilous 51 for 3 in 18 overs to a total of 227 for 6 in 50.
Azharuddin slammed two sixes and four fours in his 103-ball innings with good support from Rahul Dravid, who made 69, including six fours.
Off-spinner Muthiah Muralitharan took no wickets but was the pick of the Sri Lankan bowling, conceding 30 runs in his 10 overs. Vaas chipped in with two for 35 off eight overs.
